_about: Turn animations, measured through the viewer's own clipFor -- the clip it PLAYS, retargeted onto the model by global bone id. NOT the raw motion file: its node 00 track is in another basis and gave angles wrong by over 100 degrees (Seregios' Motion[51] read -32.5 there against -177 played). A turn animation is the BODY turning while the engine carries the heading, so node 00 leans out and comes home. What qualifies: the lean gets past 25 degrees, the net is under 15, the clip is under 120 frames, and it TRAVELS UNDER 2 METRES -- without that last one a walk or a charge came through, whose body sways as far as a turn leans (Rathian's Motion[7]_loop travels 16.8m). `deg` is THE FIRST SWING past 15 degrees, followed to its extreme, NOT the largest excursion: a turn clip can swing twice, and Seregios' Motion[35] (left then right) and Motion[36] (right then left) are a true mirror pair that the largest-excursion reading made lean the same way. `pair` is the clip of the same list and length leaning the other way. REGENERATE through window.__view.clipFor over every monster's lists (scratchpad/vgen.js). THE RULE IS THE VIEWER'S, NOT THE ROM'S -- the ROM's own mark for a turn is in the action layer and is not read; the mirrored pairs are corroboration, not a source.
